cna_version.description: Version of the CNA specification being used.

name.description: Name of the network definition. Used as the output P4 filename when --output is not specified.

consts.description: Named bit-width constants available as P4 const declarations and as indicator_value references.

field.description: Name of the constant. Used verbatim as a P4 identifier (after sanitisation).

bit_width.description: Width of the constant in bits.

oneOf.description: Hex literal (e.g. '0x800') or any valid P4 constant expression.

typedefs.description: Named bit-width type aliases emitted as P4 typedef declarations. Can be referenced by name in header field definitions.

bit_width.description: Width of the type in bits.

protocols.description: Protocol definitions. Each describes a set of header fields and a role.

id.description: Unique identifier for this protocol type. Referenced by networks[].type and composition[].encapsulation_protocol.

role.description: forwarding: instantiated per network instance, participates in composition and forwarding. session: instantiated once per type, attached to a network via session_protocols and extracted conditionally.

headers.description: Ordered list of fields in this protocol's header.

networks.description: Network instances. Each instantiates a forwarding protocol and optionally attaches session protocols.

id.description: Unique instance identifier. Becomes the P4 header name (e.g. 'eth1' -> header eth1_t).

type.description: Protocol type to instantiate. Must match the id of a protocol with role 'forwarding'.

session_protocols.description: Session protocols conditionally extracted after this network's header based on a field value.

protocol.description: id of a protocol with role 'session'.

indicator_field.description: Qualified field reference (networkId.fieldName) in this network's header whose value selects the session protocol.

indicator_value.description: Value the indicator_field must match to trigger extraction. May be a named constant from consts[] or a raw P4 literal (e.g. '6' or '0x06'). Emitted verbatim as a P4 select case label.

header_field.description: A single field within a protocol header. Must supply either 'type' (referencing a typedef) or 'bit_width'.

field.description: Field name. Used as the P4 field identifier.

type.description: Named type alias. Must match the 'field' of an entry in typedefs[].

bit_width.description: Explicit width in bits. Used when no named typedef applies.

field.description: Qualified field reference (networkId.fieldName) to match on. Translated to hdr.<networkId>.<fieldName> in the P4 table key.

action_parameter.description: A parameter passed into a forwarding action. Must supply either 'type' or 'bit_width'.

oneOf.description: No type or bit_width — zero-parameter action.

operation.description: A single operation within a forwarding action.

oneOf.description: set_field: assign a value to a header field.

from_param.description: Name of the action parameter whose value to use.

oneOf.description: decrement: subtract a fixed amount from a header field.

amount.description: Amount to subtract. Defaults to 1 if omitted.

id.description: Unique action identifier across all composition entries. Becomes the P4 action name.

parameters.description: Action parameters. Empty array for actions that take no arguments (e.g. drop).

operations.description: Ordered list of operations this action performs.

layering_composition.description: Layering: the overlay protocol is carried inside the underlay, identified by a field value in the underlay header.

overlay.description: Network instance id of the overlay (inner) network.

underlay.description: Network instance id of the underlay (outer) network.

session_identifier.description: The underlay header field and value that signals the overlay is present.

field.description: Qualified field reference (networkId.fieldName) in the underlay header.

value.description: Value that triggers the parser transition to the overlay state. May be a named constant or raw P4 literal.

match_keys.description: Fields used as table match keys for forwarding decisions in the overlay.

forwarding_actions.description: Actions available in the overlay's forwarding table.

subduction_composition.description: Subduction: the overlay is tunnelled through the underlay, optionally via an encapsulation protocol. Ingress shared_links define when to enter the tunnel.

overlay.description: Network instance id of the tunnelled (inner) network.

underlay.description: Network instance id of the encapsulating (outer) network.

encapsulation_protocol.description: Optional network instance id of an intermediate encapsulation header (e.g. GRE) between underlay and overlay. If present, the parser transitions underlay -> encapsulation -> overlay.

shared_links.description: Links that describe how packets enter and exit the tunnel.

id.description: Unique identifier for this shared link.

direction.description: ingress: packet enters the tunnel (parser selects overlay). egress: packet leaves the tunnel.

selection_predicate.description: Required for ingress links. The underlay field and value that identify a tunnelled packet.

field.description: Qualified field reference (networkId.fieldName) in the underlay header.

value.description: Value that identifies a tunnelled packet. May be a named constant or raw P4 literal.

delegate_to_underlay.description: For egress links: whether tunnel exit processing is delegated to the underlay network.

match_keys.description: Fields used as table match keys for forwarding decisions in the overlay.

forwarding_actions.description: Actions available in the overlay's forwarding table.
